Archival Dispatch: 24 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Kaliman, Ripley's One-Minute Curiosities, and Hoosier Hot Shots Novelty Jazz

Batch 45 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 45 resolves 24 historic radio broadcasts across legendary Latin American radio adventure serials, syndicated network curiosities, and Midwest novelty jazz: 8 sequential serialized adventure broadcasts from Radio Cadena Nacional's landmark superhero serial Kalimán - El Hombre Increíble (1967–1971, spanning Los Misterios de Bonampak, El Valle de los Vampiros, La Araña Negra, and El Juego de la Muerte), 8 syndicated one-minute vignettes from Robert L. Ripley's Ripley's Believe It or Not - One Minute Episodes (1948), and 8 syndicated comedy jazz transcription discs from the Hoosier Hot Shots (1950–1952).
